relationships.subject: cisplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Following cisplatin treatment PPARγ protein was reduced in DRG and was associated with oxidative stress [25].

relationships.subject: PPARγ
relationships.evidence_quote: PPARγ regulates Nrf2, a master redox-sensing transcription factor that binds the antioxidant response element (ARE)

relationships.subject: resolvin E1
relationships.evidence_quote: Recently, resolvin E1 was determined to bind to the ligand binding domain of PPARγ with affinity comparable to rosiglitazone [106]

relationships.subject: reactive oxygen species
relationships.evidence_quote: Recent studies indicate that ROS are pivotal in CIPN by decreasing axonal outgrowth and promoting abnormal impulse transmission, hyperexcitability, spontaneous or ectopic discharge, and pain

relationships.subject: PPARγ
relationships.evidence_quote: PPARγ agonists mitigate neuroinflammation in two ways: 1) by direct inhibition of NF-kB and 2) by increasing expression of enzymes that decrease ROS.

key_findings: Review: endogenous antioxidant pathways, especially PPARγ (with Nrf2), may prevent chemotherapy-induced painful neuropathy by limiting ROS.
